test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
solution:
Logic : (1st number) × (1st Number - 1)² = 2nd Number

 
• Option 01 : (7, 252)

​7 × 6² = 7 × 36 = 252

 
• Option 02 : (6, 216)

6 × 5² = 6 × 25 = 150

 
• Option 03 : (8, 392)

8 × 7² = 8 × 49 = 392

 
• Option 04 : (5, 80)

5 × 4² = 5 × 16 = 80

**∴ Option 02 is the odd number pair.**
